customInkSnippets.name: Trait Check
customInkSnippets.ink:
~temp text = //"option text"
~temp trait = //trait_name"
~temp ap_cost = 0

~temp mod_val = 0
~temp mod_text = ""
- (mods) //add trait-check modifiers

- (option)
->trait_option(text, trait, mod_val, mod_text, not counter_roll, ap_cost,->pass, ->fail)
- (pass) //on success
	->ERROR.loose_end
- (fail) //on fail
	->ERROR.loose_end
